subject: MAP draft: technical evaluation SOW, milestones & responsibilities (MedStream)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@medstream.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: technical evaluation SOW, milestones & responsibilities (MedStream)

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the technical evaluation milestone (attached as MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx). High-level recap and asks so we can lock timelines: 

- Success criteria (proposed):
  • Model quality: F1/accuracy thresholds per your sample prompt set (see sheet "Metrics")
  • Latency target: P95 generation latency <= 150ms for 512-token prompts in the production-like workload
  • Cost target: inference unit economics to be under $0.45 / 1k tokens for the shortlisted model/config
  • Stability: <1% request error rate under 95th percentile concurrency for the trial profile

- Model shortlist (initial): Llama-3-70B-instruct (quantized), Mistral-v2-22B, and Orca-Mini-13B (higher-precision baseline). We included a fallback L2 variant (lower-cost, lower-accuracy) in the slate.

- Technical evaluation plan (milestones & owners):
  1) Benchmarks defined (deliverable: benchmark_slate.csv) — owner: Ben Carter — due: 10/20
  2) Trial infra reservation (deliverable: reserved nodes + runbook) — owner: Karthik Iyer — due: 10/22
  3) Warm-up runs + KV/prefix caching check (deliverable: run logs) — owner: Ben Carter — due: 10/27
  4) Quality & latency readout (deliverable: consolidated report + candidate pick) — owner: Marissa Cole (coordinator) — due: 10/30
  5) Rollout gating & fallback plan — owner: Marissa Cole — due: 11/05

- Dependencies:
  • MedStream to provide canonical sample prompts and 3 days of anonymized telemetry (if available) by 10/14
  • Network access for private VPC trials (if needed) — lead: MedStream IT (Tom Benson)
  • Confirmation on acceptable cost ceiling for pilot runs

Next steps / asks from you: please confirm the model shortlist and the availability window for the technical deep-dive (we suggested 10/12–10/14). Once you confirm, Ben and Karthik will lock infra and test data needs and I’ll update the MAP.

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB), benchmark-slate.csv (csv, 8KB)

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@medstream.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tom.benson@medstream.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: technical evaluation SOW, milestones & responsibilities (MedStream)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

1) Model shortlist: OK to run the three you suggested but can we also add a 7B smaller model as a low-cost baseline (our team is concerned about cost on lower-end endpoints).
2) Sample prompts: I will upload the canonical prompt set and a small telemetry slice to the Drive link you shared by EOD Monday (10/12). Note — data will be anonymized.
3) Telemetry/visibility: we need a short spec for what telemetry you require (traces, per-request tokens, KV-cache hit rates) and how long Redwood will retain logs from trial runs.
4) Network: Our infra team (Tom) will confirm whether we need VPC peering or if we can run everything via your hosted endpoints. If VPC is needed, they’ll need the rollout network diagram.

Availability for the technical deep-dive: 10/13 at 10:00am PT works best for our ML infra and platform folks.

Look forward to seeing the updated MAP with the 7B baseline added and the telemetry retention details.

Best,

Lisa Park
Head of ML Platform, MedStream Health
lisa.park@medstream.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: MedStream MAP — owners & infra ask (please confirm)

Team — quick internal note after Lisa’s reply.

Summary / asks:
- Add a 7B baseline model to the benchmark slate (Ben, please add to benchmark_slate.csv).
- Ben: own benchmark runs and build the initial scripts (10/20 deliverable). Focus on 512-token prompt profile + batch sizes 1/4/8. Capture P50/P95/P99 latencies and tail error rates.
- Karthik: reserve nodes and prepare access model (either Redwood Dedicated trial or a hosted dedicated slice). Need confirmation on VPC peering only if Tom’s team requires it — estimated 2-3 nodes for the initial run. Target complete by 10/22.
- Marissa: lead the readout and coordinate the vendor-facing report to MedStream (10/30). Draft the gating criteria doc for rollout (include rollback/fallback options).

Dependencies flagged:
- We need the sample prompts + telemetry by 10/14 (Lisa said she’ll upload on 10/12). If that slips more than 48 hours we’ll need to push the benchmark schedule accordingly.

Can each of you reply with an ACK and any obvious conflicts? I’ll update the MAP and send the revised version to MedStream after I hear back.

Thanks —
Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: MedStream MAP — owners & infra ask (please confirm)

ACK from me. I’ll add the 7B baseline and push the updated benchmark_slate.csv to the Drive folder today. Plan for initial runs on 10/21 (give us one buffer day for infra), will capture the requested metrics (P50/P95/P99, tokens/request, KV hit-rate). I’ll also add a short README with the run commands and expected outputs so MedStream can reproduce.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
